schema.heygen_video_id: HeyGen's own video id, set once submitted
schema.updated_at: ISO timestamp of the last status change
schema.error: set once status is failed, HeyGen's error message
schema.instagram_publish: { status: container_processing|published|failed, container_id?, media_id?, error?, attempted_at, published_at? } -- set by the publish-agent
schema.facebook_publish: { status: published|failed, media_id?, error?, attempted_at, published_at? } -- set by the publish-agent
